For celebrations and luxury days we charter three yachts on Koh Samui: Red Baron, a 98 ft wooden junk for up to 70 guests (from 41,000 THB for a 3-hour sunset dinner cruise, price for up to 20), and two motor yachts for up to 12 guests, Casablanca (41 ft, from 50,000 THB for a 4-hour half day) and Minor Affair (a 61 ft Sunseeker, from 255,000 THB for an 8-hour day). Prices are per charter, not per person. Every charter is quoted to your date and route, then paid by secure link in THB.

Yachts and catamarans you can book online

Every boat below shows its price per boat, the guests that price covers and what is included. Choose a date, pay securely in THB and we confirm by email or WhatsApp.

Which yacht for which occasion

Large parties, weddings and company days: Red Baron

Red Baron is a traditional wooden junk built at a shipyard in Surat Thani, with the high stern and wide decks of a classic Gulf of Thailand junk. At 98 ft it takes up to 70 guests plus crew, and meals, soft drinks, a guide, snorkel equipment, towels, fuel and insurance are included. It is the right boat for a wedding party, a big birthday, a family reunion or a company outing, and its 3-hour sunset dinner cruise is the cheapest way to put 20 people on a private yacht at sunset. Programmes run from the 3-hour sunset dinner to a 6-hour half day, a 9-hour cruise around Koh Samui or Koh Phangan and a 10-hour day to Ang Thong. A junk is slow, so for far-off islands with a big group allow the full day.

Couples, families and small groups: Casablanca

Casablanca is a 41 ft motor yacht with two cabins and two bathrooms that takes up to 12 guests. It suits a family, two couples or a small group of friends who want privacy, shade and somewhere to get changed, at a fraction of a superyacht price. Half days run 4 hours (10:00–14:00) to Koh Som or Koh Phangan; full days run 8 hours (09:00–17:00) to Koh Phangan, Koh Madsum (Pig Island), Ang Thong or Koh Tao. A paddle board, fishing equipment, snorkel gear, a BBQ and a sound system are on board, an English-speaking guide comes with you, and you may bring your own food and drinks or order a Thai food or barbecue package.

A luxury day: Minor Affair

Minor Affair is a Sunseeker Manhattan 60, the largest motor yacht in our fleet at 61 ft (18.7 m), with guest cabins, an upper deck and room for 12. Every programme is a full 8-hour day: a cruise around Koh Phangan or Ang Thong Marine Park from 255,000 THB, with Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan or a cruise around Koh Samui at a higher price. Return land transfers, an English-speaking guide, snorkel gear, kayaks, fishing rods, soft drinks and seasonal fruit are included, and diving can be arranged on request. Lunch and wine are arranged in advance at extra cost. This is the boat for a milestone birthday, an anniversary or a proposal where everything is looked after.

Yacht, catamaran or speedboat

A yacht is not always the right answer. If you want to cover distance cheaply, a private speedboat is faster and costs from 19,000 THB. If you want stability and deck space for a group of 10 to 45, a catamaran from 20,000 THB is excellent value. Choose a yacht when the boat itself is part of the occasion: cabins, bathrooms, crew service, a sunset dinner for 50 or the comfort of a 61 ft Sunseeker.

Casablanca or Minor Affair

Both motor yachts take 12 guests, so the choice is about the day you want and the budget. Casablanca is the practical luxury option: a 41 ft yacht with two cabins and two bathrooms, half days as well as full days, and the freedom to bring your own food and drinks. Minor Affair is a different class of boat: a 61 ft Sunseeker with a bigger deck, more cabin space and a crew that takes care of everything, including land transfers from your hotel or villa. It only runs full 8-hour days.

For comparison, our shared Ang Thong VIP day tour takes only 15 guests on a big speedboat for 4,500 THB per adult, which is a good middle ground if you want a comfortable Ang Thong day without chartering a whole yacht (Ang Thong is open from 16 December to 31 October).

Who a yacht suits, and who it doesn't

A yacht day is excellent for a celebration, for a group that wants to spend the day together in comfort, for families with grandparents who need shade, cabins and a bathroom, and for anyone who wants the boat itself to be the experience. It is less good if your main aim is to see as much of Ang Thong or Koh Tao as possible: a speedboat gets there faster and leaves more time at the islands. It is also not the best value for two people on a budget: our shared Pig Island Sunset Tour (1,550 THB per adult with dinner) or a private sailing catamaran from 20,000 THB gives you a sunset on the water for far less. Be honest with yourselves about seasickness too: if anyone is prone, choose a sheltered route and the gentle ride of the junk.

Routes

Our yachts leave from piers on Samui's north coast; we confirm the pier and meeting time with your booking. The captain adjusts every route on the day for wind, tide and sea.

West coast and the White Lotus coastline

Season 3 of The White Lotus, aired in 2025, was filmed largely at the Four Seasons Koh Samui on the island's north-west tip at Laem Yai. A yacht day along the north and west coast passes the resort's hillside villas, then runs south past Bang Por, Nathon, Lipa Noi and the cliffs at Taling Ngam to the Five Islands, where the sun sets in the evening. You see the resort from the sea only: we do not land at private resorts. Our White Lotus Koh Samui guide covers what was filmed where. This coast is calmest from January to September. A good plan is to leave in the early afternoon, swim off the north-west coast, then run south to be off Taling Ngam for the sunset; ask us to quote it as a custom route, since it is not one of the fixed programmes and the price depends on the yacht and the hours.

Ang Thong National Marine Park

Forty-two limestone islands about 30 km west of Samui: the Emerald Lake on Koh Mae Ko, the viewpoint climb on Koh Wua Talab, kayaking and snorkelling. Minor Affair runs it as an 8-hour day, Casablanca as an 8-hour full day and Red Baron as a 10-hour day. The park is closed every year from 1 November to 15 December and reopens on 16 December; the park fee of 300 THB per foreign adult and 150 THB per child is paid in cash and is not included. See our Ang Thong guide.

Pig Island and the southern islands

Casablanca's full day to Koh Madsum adds the beach pigs and the reef at Koh Tan. These islands sit off the south-west coast, sheltered from the north-east monsoon, so they are the best yacht route in November and December. The Koh Madsum landing fee is about 50 THB per person in cash. For a cheaper private trip to the same islands from Thong Krut, see the Pig Island private speedboat (11,950 THB for up to 10).

Koh Phangan

Casablanca runs half and full days to Koh Phangan; Minor Affair's from price is a cruise around the island; Red Baron runs a 9-hour cruise around Koh Phangan. Expect stops at beaches without road access, such as Haad Yuan, Than Sadet and Bottle Beach, depending on the sea. Avoid Haad Rin on Full Moon nights unless the party is the plan.

Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan

Casablanca and Minor Affair run 8-hour days to Koh Tao, the furthest route (about 1.5 hours each way by fast boat). The Koh Nang Yuan landing fee is 250 THB per adult in cash, and plastic bottles, fins and drones are not allowed on the island.

Koh Som and the north-east coast

Casablanca's 4-hour half day to Koh Som is the shortest yacht trip we offer: sheltered water off the north-east coast, a swim and snorkel stop and back by 14:00.

A yacht day, hour by hour

Start and finish times come from each yacht's standard programme; the times in between are typical and set by the captain on the day.

Casablanca half day to Koh Som (4 hours)

  1. 10:00 Board at the pier; safety briefing and drinks
  2. 10:45 Anchor off Koh Som: swim, snorkel, paddle board
  3. 12:00 BBQ or your own picnic on deck
  4. 13:15 Cruise back along the coast
  5. 14:00 Back at the pier

Minor Affair around Koh Phangan (8 hours)

  1. Morning Land transfer from your hotel or villa to the pier
  2. Start Cross to Koh Phangan's south coast on the upper deck
  3. Mid-morning Swim and snorkel off a quiet bay; kayaks in the water
  4. Lunch Pre-ordered lunch on board or at a beach restaurant
  5. Afternoon Continue around the island with a second swim stop
  6. After 8 hours Back at the pier and land transfer to your hotel

Red Baron sunset dinner cruise (3 hours)

  1. Late afternoon Board at the pier
  2. First hour Cruise along the coast with drinks on deck
  3. Sunset Between about 17:55 (November) and 18:45 (July)
  4. After sunset Dinner on deck as the lights come on along the shore
  5. 3 hours after boarding Back at the pier

Catering and extras

On Red Baron, meals are part of the charter. On Casablanca you choose: bring your own food and drinks free of charge, use the on-board BBQ, or order a Thai food or barbecue package. On Minor Affair, lunch and wine are arranged in advance from the yacht's menu and wine list, and additional service staff can be added. Other extras we can quote on request include a cake, flowers and decorations, a photographer, a DJ for Red Baron, diving on Minor Affair, and land transfers where they are not included. Give us at least a few days' notice for catering and decorations, and more over Christmas, New Year and Songkran.

Good to know: prices in Thai resorts and restaurants marked "++" add 10% service charge and 7% VAT. Our quote shows a single total in THB, so you know exactly what you pay.

Prices and seasons

The prices on this page are our published "from" rates: 41,000 THB for Red Baron (sunset dinner, up to 20 guests), 50,000 THB for Casablanca (4-hour Koh Som) and 255,000 THB for Minor Affair (8 hours, Koh Phangan or Ang Thong). Full days and longer routes cost more, and Red Baron charges per guest above 20. Over Christmas and New Year, demand for yachts is at its highest and dates go weeks ahead, so your quote confirms the price for your exact date.

Christmas and New Year on a yacht

Christmas Eve (Thursday 24 December 2026) is also a Full Moon Party night, and New Year's Eve brings fireworks on Chaweng, Fisherman's Village, Lamai, Maenam and Choeng Mon. Yachts for 24–26 and 30–31 December and 1 January are the first to go, so enquire in November if you can. Night charters to watch fireworks from the water are quoted case by case, depending on the yacht, the captain and the sea. Flights and ferries off the island are full on 1–2 January, so do not plan a yacht day on your departure date. Our Christmas and New Year guide has the full holiday calendar, and the Koh Samui events page lists every date.

Planning a party or wedding on Red Baron

A 70-guest day on the water needs more planning than a family charter. These are the points we work through with every large group:

  • Numbers: the from price covers 20 guests; every guest above that pays a supplement that depends on the programme (higher for longer days and Ang Thong). Give us a final number a few days before so we can set the catering and the life-jacket count.
  • Timing: the sunset dinner cruise is 3 hours; for a wedding party with speeches and dancing, the 6-hour programme gives you time to anchor, swim and still be on deck for the sunset.
  • Getting guests to the pier: Red Baron leaves from Samui's north coast. Large groups usually come by minivan; we can quote transfers from your hotel or villa, and guests on steep hillside roads may need a meeting point at the bottom of the hill.
  • Food and drink: meals and soft drinks are included. Tell us about vegetarian, vegan, halal or allergy needs when you enquire. Other drinks, a cake, flowers and a DJ are quoted as extras.
  • Children and older guests: both are welcome. Children's life jackets are provided and must be worn on board. Tell us about anyone with limited mobility so we can plan boarding with the crew.
  • Weather back-up: agree a second date when you book if your dates are flexible, especially from October to December. If we cancel for weather, you choose a full refund or a new date.
  • Alcohol on Buddhist holy days: shops cannot sell alcohol on holy days (in 2027: 21 February, 20 May, 18–19 July and about 15 October), so buy ahead if you bring your own.

Getting to the pier

Our yachts leave from piers on Samui's north coast; we send the exact pier as a map pin with your confirmation. From Chaweng the north-coast piers are about 15–20 minutes by road, from Lamai about 30 minutes, from Maenam about 15–20 minutes and from the west coast (Lipa Noi, Taling Ngam) about 45 minutes. Minor Affair includes return land transfers; on the other yachts, transfers are quoted on request or you can come by taxi or Grab. Leave a buffer in the afternoon on Fridays near Fisherman's Village, where the beach road closes for the Walking Street. See getting around Koh Samui and the pier list on our places map.

Safety on board

Every boat we charter carries life jackets in adult and children's sizes, first aid and a VHF radio, and our captains are licensed by the Thai Marine Department. The captain decides on the route and on swimming stops, and we never load a yacht above its maximum. Two Samui-specific risks are worth knowing. First, the sea: from October to December the east and north-east coasts get monsoon swell and rip currents near the beaches, which is why we use the sheltered south-west route then. Second, box jellyfish: nine of the ten deaths recorded in Thailand since 2002 were in waters off Samui and Phangan, and the risk is higher in calm seas and after rain; swim where the crew suggests, and pour vinegar on any sting for at least 30 seconds without rubbing. Alcohol and swimming do not mix: don't swim after drinking, and follow the crew's call on when it is safe to get in.

Practical tips for a yacht day

  • Shoes: bare feet or clean soft-soled shoes on deck; leave heels on shore.
  • Sun: reef-friendly sunscreen, a hat and a light long-sleeved top; the reflection off the water burns fast.
  • Cash: bring cash for park and island fees (Ang Thong 300 THB per foreign adult) and any tips.
  • Children: welcome on every yacht; children's life jackets are provided and must be worn on board.
  • Seasickness: the junk and the motor yachts ride more gently than a speedboat; if you are prone, ask a pharmacist about seasickness tablets before the day, stay on deck in the fresh air and choose a sheltered route.
  • Pregnancy and mobility: tell us when you enquire; we will suggest a short, calm route and a boat that is easy to board.
  • Swimming: box jellyfish have caused deaths in Samui and Phangan waters; swim where the crew suggests, and vinegar is the first aid for a sting.
  • Tips: optional, given directly to the crew.

When to book a yacht

Book as early as you know your dates. Red Baron and Minor Affair are single boats with no twin to fall back on, so a popular date can only be sold once. As a guide: for Christmas, New Year and Chinese New Year (6 February 2027), enquire one to two months ahead; for Songkran (13–15 April 2027) and the Samui Regatta week (22–29 May 2027), a month ahead; at other times, a week or two is usually enough, and short-notice dates are sometimes possible, so it is always worth asking on WhatsApp. If you are flexible, tell us two or three dates: we pick the one with the best sea forecast.

Combine a yacht day with the rest of your trip

Most guests plan one yacht day and fill the rest of the week with shared trips. The Pig Island speedboat tour (1,450 THB per adult) runs every day of the year; the Ang Thong big boat tour (1,500 THB) is the relaxed, cheaper way to see the park from 16 December; and on Full Moon nights our shared speedboat to Haad Rin costs 1,400 THB return with hotel pickup from most areas. The events calendar shows what is on during your stay.

How booking works

  1. Enquire. Message us on WhatsApp (+66 63 704 0888) with the occasion, number of guests (adults, children 3–11, infants 0–2), date, half or full day and any catering. Enquiries are free and commit you to nothing.
  2. Get a written quote. We check the yacht and the forecast and send the route, times, inclusions, extras, pier and cancellation terms.
  3. Pay by secure link. You pay through a secure card payment link (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay), charged in THB.
  4. Confirmation. We confirm by email or WhatsApp, send the pier location and meeting time, and confirm transfer times the evening before.

Cancellation and weather

The cancellation terms for your yacht are written on your quote before you pay. For comparison, our standard day-trip policy is a full refund 48 hours or more before departure, 50% at 24–48 hours, and no refund under 24 hours or for a no-show. The captain decides on the day whether the sea is safe. If it isn't, we offer a sheltered route or another date; if we cancel for weather, you choose a full refund or a new date. Check the swell on our sea conditions page before you choose a route.
